title: Ballot
description: Ballot record of the "who leaves" vote (GOV-7, GOV-23). The core takes the choice value from the P4 answer with the forced schema of this attempt, not from the complete body; the core writes forced without a model call if the choice list has one seat; the core writes defaulted by the code rule when the model refuses. In a round there is exactly one ballot per voter; until the round closes no bot sees the ballots. Reason codes come from the closed list spec/model/ballot-reasons.yaml. The core never writes farm-manager as a choice: L never holds the manager seat (GOV-12, GOV-17).

choice.description: Seat id commission:<seat number from the tenant charter>. The pattern also admits farm-manager for compatibility, but the core never writes it: L never holds the manager seat (GOV-12, GOV-17).

reasons.description: Up to 3 reason codes from spec/model/ballot-reasons.yaml (GOV-7).

model_profile.description: Model profile of the attempt's actual P4 call, fallback included (GW-5); null for forced and defaulted ballots. Code reads it for the flag single_model_bloc (COM-12).

reissue.description: Reissue number, at most ballots.reissue_max (charter maximum 100).
